selected_experts.reason: To confirm the object is correctly classified as a necklace and not a different type of jewelry or ornament.
To verify the physical connectivity of the chain links and the attachment of the pendants, checking for floating parts or fusion artifacts.
To assess the realism of the metal reflections and the sharpness of the small stone details, identifying subtle texture smearing.

focus_areas: Connectivity of chain links (are they truly interlocked or just touching?)
Sharpness and distinctness of individual stones in the pendants
Physical plausibility of the attachment points between pendants and chain
Consistency of lighting and reflections on the metal surfaces
custom_prompts_for_reflector: Pay close attention to the 'melting' effect in the stone settings. AI often struggles with many small, similar objects (like gems) and blurs them together. Also, scrutinize the connection points; do the pendants hang logically, or do they seem to emerge from the chain without a clear link? The classifier will likely say 'necklace', but the structural integrity of the jewelry's construction is the key failure mode here.
